Case Studies

Work that turned audiences into revenue

Four brands, four different starting points. The same discipline every time, understand the customer, build the system, measure what matters.

Promix Nutrition — Clean protein and performance supplements, sold direct on Shopify and trusted by professional athletes.

Klaviyo RetentionEmail and SMSShopifySubscriptions

Built on Repeat Purchase: How Promix Nutrition Rebuilt Its Klaviyo Retention Program

Promix had strong acquisition but a retention program that could not keep up. We rebuilt the whole of Klaviyo around one idea, the reorder.

The Challenge

Strong acquisition, thin retention infrastructure. Shallow segmentation, underbuilt flows, inconsistent creative and disconnected data meant repeat buyers were left to chance.

The Solution

A full Klaviyo rebuild around the reorder. Every core flow rebuilt, welcome, post purchase, replenishment, winback, browse and cart abandonment and VIP, with segmentation by behaviour, subscription specific logic, email and SMS on one cadence, dynamic content and testing. Data connected across Shopify, Wonderment, Elevar and Junip.

The Results

Higher retention and higher lifetime value, with email and SMS becoming a dependable revenue channel across the first two years of the program, 2021 to 2023.

+26%90 day retention rate
+34%60 day customer LTV
$6.5MKlaviyo attributed revenue, email and SMS
“Ben and his team are extremely responsive, not passive and actively make suggestions to improve performance.”
Albert Matheny — CEO, Promix Nutrition

BYROE — Luxury skincare born in New York, built on superfood inspired formulas.

Shopify 2.0 RebuildBrand StorytellingUX Design

A Modern Canvas for Storytelling: How BYROE Reimagined Its Shopify Experience

BYROE partnered with us to rebuild its website on Shopify Online Store 2.0, so the store could finally tell the brand story the products deserved.

The Challenge

Brand storytelling for a modern Shopify experience, held back by rigid templates that made every page feel the same and every update a developer task.

The Solution

A design forward, content flexible Shopify 2.0 theme. Full migration to Online Store 2.0, a dynamic content architecture, a modern minimalist design system and a streamlined user experience built mobile first.

The Results

A flexible, design led platform built for growth, with a custom section library and a cohesive design system that reduced dependence on developers.

Complete migration to Online Store 2.0 Custom section library Reimagined UX, mobile first Cohesive design system Reduced dependence on developers
“Our goal with the new BYROE site was to create a space that feels as intentional and sensory as our products.”
Amy Roe — Founder and CEO, BYROE

Why NeilHub

An agency that treats your list like revenue

Most brands do not have an email problem. They have an underbuilt Klaviyo account. Here is how we work differently.

1

Klaviyo first, always

Email and SMS retention is all we do. Every strategist, designer and builder on your account works inside Klaviyo every day, so nothing is lost to generalists.

2

Revenue reporting, not vanity metrics

We report on click rate, conversion and attributed revenue, and we show you which flow, segment or campaign produced it. Opens alone never made anyone money.

3

Proactive, not passive

We bring you the next test, the next segment and the next campaign idea before you ask. Your account gets a team that pushes performance forward, not one that waits for briefs.

4

Built around repeat purchase

Acquisition gets the first order. We build the flows, segments and campaigns that get the second, third and tenth, where your profit actually lives.

How We Work

From audit to compounding growth

01

Audit

We open your account and grade everything, flows, campaigns, segmentation, deliverability and revenue attribution, then rank the fixes by impact.

02

Strategy

You get a lifecycle plan, which flows to build, which segments to create, and the campaign calendar that supports them, all tied to revenue targets.

03

Build and Launch

Copy, design and build happen in house. Every flow and template is QA tested across devices and inboxes before it goes live.

04

Test and Optimize

We test offers, creative and timing on a set cadence, report the numbers plainly, and roll the winners into the rest of the program.
